newsitem.title: USA: AMR expands code sharing with Poland's LOT.
newsitem.headline: AMR expands code sharing with Poland's LOT.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said Tuesday it is expanding its code sharing agreement with LOT Polish Airlines between the United States and Poland to 26 flights a week.

American said it will code share on additional LOT flights between Chicago and Warsaw and later this summer between Newark, N.J., and Warsaw. American already code shares flights between New York's Kennedy airport and Warsaw.
LOT will start code sharing on American's flights between Chicago and Miami and between New York's Kennedy airport and Los Angeles.
